title: Regional Sales Post Strong Quarterly Growth
titleZh: 區域銷售帶動第一季營收成長強勁
paragraphs: Sunrise Trading reported strong results for the first fiscal quarter. Total revenue rose twelve percent compared to the same period last year, and net profit followed a similar path. Analysts credit the growth to steady demand across three regions and lower material cost.

The finance team noted that gross margin also improved, rising from 31 percent to 34 percent. Executives said the forecast for the next quarter remains positive, though they warned that rising interest rates could raise the cost of new loans.
The board plans to review the dividend policy at the next meeting. Shareholders will receive an updated statement once the review is complete.
